questions: If multiple products have the same rating, is any secondary sort order required (e.g., alphabetical by product name, or preserve original list order)?
Should the function raise an error if the lengths of products, ratings, and weights do not match, or should it proceed with some default behavior?
Are the weights required to sum to 1, or can they be any non‑negative numbers (choices will normalize them)?
Can ratings be any type (e.g., strings, floats) or only integers as in the example?
Is the random seed applied globally (affecting other random calls in the same program) or only locally to choices?
Should the DataFrame index be reset after sorting (i.e., 0..n-1) or left as the original row order?
If the products list contains duplicates, should each be treated as a separate row with its own random rating?
Is the function allowed to modify the input lists (products, ratings, weights) in any way?
